body: @holly-cummins might be something of interest for you.
I'm looking at this and will report back soon

A temporary workaround is to use the following system property when launching the tests:

```
-Djava.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.threadFactory=io.quarkus.bootstrap.forkjoin.QuarkusForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory
```

The reason this fails in Java 25 is because the `ForkJoinPool` now does https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/blob/jdk-25%2B36/src/java.base/share/classes/java/util/concurrent/ForkJoinPool.java#L2085, which ends up calling https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/blob/jdk-25%2B36/src/java.base/share/classes/java/util/concurrent/ForkJoinWorkerThread.java#L280.

The above means that our [hack](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/bc4955b027800abd07c066f63120bc37b532f634/core/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/runner/bootstrap/ForkJoinClassLoading.java#L22) no longer works.

issue.title: Ensure that FJP threads can load resources in tests

body: I looked around in the JDK codebase and didn't see any easy way to turn off the reset feature (maybe @dmlloyd has a way), but in any case, I think our hack needs to go away, and we just need to make sure we always use our thread factory.
